instrument: FERC show cause orders to six RTOs/ISOs on large load integration (June 18, 2026), Dockets EL26-67 (PJM), EL26-68 (SPP), EL26-69 (NYISO), EL26-70 (MISO), EL26-71 (CAISO), EL26-72 (ISO-NE)
summary: FERC issued separate section 206 show cause orders to each RTO/ISO and its transmission owners: within 60 days justify existing tariffs or file changes covering five areas (transmission service study processes, cost shifting and transparency, co-location and behind-the-meter generation, service for flexible large loads, study of generation serving proximate or co-located loads), plus a 30-day informational report on generation adequacy for large loads.

source.citation: FERC news release, June 18, 2026 (Items E-7 to E-12)

notes: Docket-to-item mapping per release links: E-7 EL26-67, E-8 EL26-70, E-9 EL26-68, E-10 EL26-71, E-11 EL26-72, E-12 EL26-69.
confidence_note: Read the FERC news release, not the six orders. RTO responses, abeyance requests and current deadlines not checked.
text: have 60 days to either justify why their current tariffs remain just and reasonable without provisions tailored to large loads, or to file tariff changes
